mapper.select:
SELECT ENTRUST_ID code FROM ETR_ENTRUST
ENTRUST_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_NAME shortName, FINPROD_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT
FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') or FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))

SELECT T.TYPE_6 finprodType,
T.TYPE_9 type9, T.TYPE_10 type10, T.TYPE_11 type11,
FIN.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, FIN.VDATE vdate, FIN.MDATE mdate, FIN.TERM_DAYS termDays, FIN.CCY ccy, PA.RECOMMENDER assetProvider, RULE.BASIS basis, TRIM(TO_CHAR(RULE.YIELD*100,'90.9999')) loadRate, mcp.counter_id issuer FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_RECOMMENT PA ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = PA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (select mcp1.* from mst_counter_party mcp1
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani on dani.BUSINESS_ID = mcp1.counter_id AND dani.MODEL_TYPE='02'
AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE IN
#{item}
) mcp ON mcp.link_id = FIN.ISSUER
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID ,(SELECT FINR.YIELD,FINR.BASIS,FINR.EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FINR WHERE FINR.CASH_ID = (SELECT T.CASH_ID FROM (SELECT CASH_ID,UPDATE_TIME FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC) T WHERE ROWNUM = 1) and FINR.EFF_DATE <= CASE WHEN (SELECT VDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ) >= #{sysDateRate} THEN (SELECT VDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ) ELSE #{sysDateRate} END ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC) RULE WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT ORDER_ID orderId, ORDER_TYPE orderType, PAY_TYPE payType, SETTLE_DATE settleDate, MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNo, PS ps, COUNTER_ACCT_NO counterAcctNo, SETTLE_AMT settleAmt, CCY ccy, SETTLE_STATUS settleStatus, PURPOSE purpose, IS_NEED_SEND isNeedSend, IS_TOTAL_TRADE isTotalTrade, ORDER_STATUS orderStatus FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS
TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT AD.PROD_REGIST_CODE FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID
FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId} AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}

SELECT T.CLOSE_PRICE FROM ( SELECT M.CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE M
BASIS_CYY = #{basisCcy} AND TRADE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND QUOT_CYY = #{quotCcy} ORDER BY TRADE_DATE DESC
) T
ROWNUM = 1

SELECT UUID uuid, ASSETPOOL assetpool, CASHNO cashno, BUSINESSID businessid, SENDMODULE sendmodule, VERIND verind, DEALTYPE dealtype, DEALTEXT dealtext, VERIND verind, DEALTEXT dealtext, DEALTYPE dealtype, TRAD trad, PORT port, MDATE mdate, VDATE vdate, AMT amt, BRANCH branch, BROK brok, SENDFLAG sendflag, CCY ccy, BASIS basis, SPREAD spread, DEALDATE dealdate, SENDFLAG sendflag, SENDFLAG sendflag FROM INTERF_SEND_OPICS
CASHNO = #{tradeId}

SELECT PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID code, PTL.PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY AUTH ON AUTH.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND (PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR PTL.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{param,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND AUTH.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND PTL.PORTFOLIO_TYPE IN (#{portType}, #{portType1})
